Package com.github.query4j.optimizer.predicate

Interface PredicatePushdownOptimizer

All Known Implementing Classes:
PredicatePushdownOptimizerImpl
public interface PredicatePushdownOptimizer
Interface for analyzing and optimizing predicate placement within queries. Detects predicates that can be pushed closer to data sources and reorders predicates to apply the most selective filters earliest for improved performance.
Since:
1.0.0

    • estimateSelectivity

      double estimateSelectivity(com.github.query4j.core.criteria.Predicate predicate)
      Estimates the selectivity of a predicate for optimization decisions. Lower selectivity values indicate more selective predicates that should be evaluated earlier.
      Parameters:
      predicate - the predicate to analyze, must not be null
      Returns:
      selectivity estimate between 0.0 (most selective) and 1.0 (least selective)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if predicate is null
